editorial.blurb: This unpretentious Thai spot delivers genuinely delicious curries and noodle dishes at reasonable prices, with a devoted following for their tender beef pad see ew and rich massaman curry.
editorial.insiderTip: Come early (around 5 PM on a Friday) to beat the rush and get your food in about five minutes; the kitchen handles the orders quickly and the vegan massaman curry is excellent if you ask the server about fish sauce substitutions.
